title: 'Spy x Family' Gets Season 4, Second Anime Movie in 2027
content: • The Spy x Family Anime Extra Mission II special event announced a fourth season and a second theatrical movie on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) for Season 4 . The new season and movie are scheduled for a 2027 premiere.

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Streams Videos for Leads Hana Ichise, Saku Ichinomiya
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series started streaming the character promotional videos for Hana Ichise and Saku Ichinomiya on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Minami-ke Season 5 Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, April 2027 Premiere
content: The previously announced Minami-ke Season 5 revealed a teaser visual and trailer along with an April 2027 premiere date. Studio LIDENFILMS is animating. Junichi Kitamura is directing the anime with Takamitsu Kono in charge of the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Minami-ke Korekara' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: • The Minami-ke Special Event 2026 revealed new staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the Season 5 on Sunday. The fifth season adapting Coharu Sakuraba 's comedy slice of life manga will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Minami-ke Korekara TV Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, April Debut
content: The " Minami-ke Special Event 2026" debuted the teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and character visuals for Minami-ke: Korekara ( Minami-ke : Going Forward), the new sequel television anime series based on Coharu Sakuraba 's Minami-ke manga , on Sunday.
author: ANN
